/kind bug

#### What this PR does / why we need it:

As far as I can see, this error seems to happen on http2 communication in golang.org/x/http. 
Thus, it passes the context to the all I/O waiting that could happen and communications instead of context.TODO(). As a result, when the test is finished, the all connection is canceled by context cancellation.
I think it will resolve the goroutine leak.
I'm welcome to teach me about other view of point, thanks.

review_comments: `k8s.io/kubernetes/test/utils/ktesting.Init` can be used to create a context which uses `t` for contextual logging and automatically gets canceled when the test is done.

I've never known this library. How useful !
Thanks.
Instead of `stopCh`, `ctx.Done()` probably also would have worked.
